figurative_meaning_en: All kinds of household tasks, from minor to major, good to bad
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে জুতা সেলাই থেকে চণ্ডীপাঠ পর্যন্ত সব কাজ করে।
গ্রামের মানুষেরা জুতা সেলাই থেকে চণ্ডীপাঠ সবকিছুতে দক্ষ।
example_sentences_in_english: She handles everything from stitching shoes to reciting Chandi.
Village folks are skilled in tasks ranging from shoe repair to religious recitations.
history: চণ্ডীপাঠ refers to the recitation of Durga Saptashati, a Hindu scripture central to Bengali Durga Puja traditions.
note: The idiom contrasts mundane labor with sacred rituals to emphasize comprehensive involvement in family duties.
